backdatedEmails.subject: Cedar Ridge fall open house - layout tours November 8
backdatedEmails.body: Hi all, Gordon here. The club voted last night: our fall open house is set for November 8, and Maple Yard is on the public tour list. Please have your track power and wiring buttoned up well before then - visitors will be running trains all afternoon. Rosa is collecting wiring status updates for the newsletter, so send us a note once your bus and feeders are in. - Gordon Petrakis, Cedar Ridge Model Railroad Club
